newsitem.title: USA: Arterial Vascular sees pricing pressures.
newsitem.headline: Arterial Vascular sees pricing pressures.

text.p: SANTA ROSA, Calif, Jan. 27 - Arterial Vascular Engineering Inc said pricing pressures and increases in operating expenses will continue to affect its earnings in the foreseeable future.

Due to ongoing litigation resulting from its purchase of technology from Endovascular Support Systems Inc and other factors, earnings for subsequent periods will likely be in line with those experienced in the quarter ended December 31, 1996, it said. For the second quarter ended dec 31, arterial reported net income of $4.6 million or $0.15 a share.
